purchase.sentence: Thank you for keeping me afloat.

byeModMenu.sentence: There was a note attached to that item when it appeared in my shop.
I have no clue what a TAB is but,
I'm sure you'll figure it out.

error.sentence: Seems like the game couldn't find the requested dialogue id...
Might wanna report that to someone.
Or don't. I'm not your dad, I can't tell you what to do.
ALSO THIS DIALOGUE IS IN NO WAY IN THE RALDIVERSE CANON. PUT DOWN YOUR GAME THEORY CAP

item_zesty.sentence: This protein bar might be stale from sitting out.
It can give you more time to run.
Anyways it's 1 quarter. Got enough for it?

item_bsoda.sentence: This here can push your problems away!
Only lasts for half a minute, but still really useful.
All for 1 quarter. Got enough for it?

item_clock.sentence: It can be used to distract Taldi for a bit.

item_safety.sentence: Bet you can use it on the robot guy.
You might also be able to use it against that Sniper.
Your choice, at the cost of 1 quarter

item_pipe.sentence: This here is pretty rare to come across.
It's like a portable version of the balloon.
You can also pick it back up!
You want it? It's yours, my friend, as long as you have 2 quarters.

item_shield.sentence: This here can shield your health, allowing you to take more damage!
I don't got a use for it, but I know you do!
Just for 1 quarter, got that on ya?

item_chug_jug.sentence: This can give you all the shield and health you can ask for!
I'll give it to you for... 2 quarters.

item_fake_quarter.sentence: Let me let you in on a little secret...
I heard the IRS Guy here cheated on his vision test
You might be able to use this to get him outta your way
How about a trade? You'll get this faker for 1 REAL quarter. Got enough for it?

item_mystery_key.sentence: That right there, good item I'd say.
It's a key to somewhere, but that somewhere could be cool.
Anyways it's 1 quarter. Got enough for it?

item_uber.sentence: This one's a gem of mine.
This beauty can make you invincible for a bit.
Best works with something like a BSODA.

item_fifteen_second_energy.sentence: It'll make you so energized, you can make you bolt your way out of trouble!
Considering a guy with a knife chased me down for this!!
But yeah, I'll give you it for 2 quarters

item_whistle.sentence: Use this when you're in a pinch.
You can whistle the Mario balloon over to you!
Surely he'll be able to help you out!
1 quarter, take it or leave it

item_mod_menu.sentence: Most definitely my most prized possession.
It just kinda appeared on my desk a little while ago: it seems to have incredible power...
Taldi doesn't seem exactly uh... happy that I have this item...
But hey, I have no use for it. So might as well make a profit, eh?

whoAreYou.sentence: I don't really specialize in anything...
Right now I'm just trying to make it by. Y'know, selling this stuff.
I mean, a long while ago I used to try and mess with old tech.
Tried to be an inventor like Taldi and all that.
I'd be down to still do it, I just haven't found anything new while going through the dumpsters...
By the way, I never caught your name, what is it?

whoAreYou_a_dave.sentence: Oh your name's Dave too? Sweet.

whoAreYou_a_harry.sentence: I think I knew someone along that name...
Haven't seen them in a LONG while...
I dunno, it was something along those lines...

whoAreYou_a_reference.sentence: Oh, nothing, it's just I feel like I've heard that name before

whoAreYou_a_profanity.sentence: Hey uh... sorry if this is a personal question...
